_comment: The two films, as data rather than as a document.
One file is the source for BOTH the narration and the camera. The voice is
generated from `say`, and the recorder walks the same list in the same
order, holding each shot for exactly as long as that line takes to speak.
Keeping them apart would mean two scripts drifting out of step, and a film
where the pointer presses Forward while the voice is still on Approvals.
`do` is what the recorder performs. `highlight` is the element the ring is
drawn around while the line is spoken. Both are read by video/record.js.
Voices chosen by the owner on 2026-10-13: en_US-joe-medium (CC0) and
es_ES-davefx-medium (CC0). Both unrestricted - nothing is owed to anybody
for either, which is why they were chosen over better-known voices.
How fast the film goes, in ONE place. These three numbers were in three
different files - the pause was written as 800 in record.js and as 0.8 in
assemble.js - and three copies of a number are three chances for the
picture and the voice to drift apart.
lengthScale is Piper's --length-scale: above 1.0 speaks slower. 1.0 was
the first film, which the owner found too fast to follow.
sentenceSilence is Piper's --sentence-silence: breath BETWEEN sentences,
which is most of what makes a voice sound like a person rather than a
list being read out.
pauseSeconds is the gap the recorder holds, and the silence assemble.js
puts between lines. They must be the same number or the film drifts.

say.en: Jericho is a private market for bulk commodities. It is invitation only. Nothing posted here appears in public, and there is no way in without an invitation. A member signs in with their own email and password.
say.es: Jericho es un mercado privado de materias primas a granel. Solo se entra por invitación. Nada de lo que se publica aquí aparece en público, y no hay forma de entrar sin una invitación. Cada miembro entra con su propio correo y contraseña.

say.en: Once you are in, everything sits on one screen. Your own offers, the whole market, and your messages. There is nothing else to learn.
say.es: Una vez dentro, todo está en una sola pantalla. Sus propias ofertas, todo el mercado y sus mensajes. No hay nada más que aprender.

say.en: To offer something, you fill in one form. What the commodity is, how much of it, the Incoterm, and where it ships from.
say.es: Para ofrecer algo, se rellena un solo formulario. Qué materia prima es, qué cantidad, el Incoterm, y desde dónde se envía.

say.en: Here: a sell offer. Copper cathodes. Twenty five thousand metric tons. LME Grade A. Terms, CIF. Shipping from Chile. That is the whole job, and it takes under a minute.
say.es: Aquí: una oferta de venta. Cátodos de cobre. Veinticinco mil toneladas métricas. Grado A de la LME. Condiciones, CIF. Envío desde Chile. Eso es todo, y lleva menos de un minuto.

say.en: Your offer now has a reference number of its own. That number is how the Operator will discuss it with you, instead of using your name. You can change the offer, renew it, or withdraw it whenever you like.
say.es: Su oferta ya tiene su propio número de referencia. Ese número es la forma en que el Operador hablará de ella con usted, en lugar de usar su nombre. Puede modificar la oferta, renovarla o retirarla cuando quiera.

say.en: Browse shows every offer on the platform, not only your own. You can filter by commodity, or search for exactly what you need.
say.es: Explorar muestra todas las ofertas de la Plataforma, no solo las suyas. Puede filtrar por materia prima, o buscar exactamente lo que necesita.

say.en: Now look closely at a row. You get the full commercial detail: the grade, the quantity, the terms, the origin. What you do not get is a name, a company, or an email address. And the member who posted it cannot see you either.
say.es: Ahora mire con atención una fila. Tiene todo el detalle comercial: el grado, la cantidad, las condiciones, el origen. Lo que no tiene es un nombre, una empresa ni un correo electrónico. Y el miembro que la publicó tampoco puede verle a usted.

say.en: If you are always looking for the same thing, save the search. It becomes a watchlist, and it tells you how many offers match it right now.
say.es: Si siempre busca lo mismo, guarde la búsqueda. Se convierte en una lista de seguimiento, y le indica cuántas ofertas coinciden en este momento.

say.en: When something interests you, you write about it. But not to the other member. You write to the Operator, and you never need to know who is on the other side.
say.es: Cuando algo le interesa, escribe sobre ello. Pero no al otro miembro. Escribe al Operador, y nunca necesita saber quién está al otro lado.

say.en: The Operator reads what you wrote, decides whether it should go, and passes it on. Nothing on this platform travels between two members on its own.
say.es: El Operador lee lo que ha escrito, decide si debe seguir adelante, y lo transmite. Nada en esta Plataforma viaja entre dos miembros por sí solo.

say.en: Their reply comes back the same way. Through the Operator, into your mailbox. Still no names, on either side.
say.es: Su respuesta vuelve por el mismo camino. A través del Operador, a su buzón. Todavía sin nombres, por ninguna de las dos partes.

say.en: Where papers matter, you simply declare which ones you hold. Nothing is ever uploaded. The platform stores no documents at all, so there is nothing here that could leak.
say.es: Cuando los documentos importan, solo se declara cuáles posee. Nunca se sube nada. La Plataforma no almacena ningún documento, así que aquí no hay nada que pueda filtrarse.

say.en: The whole platform speaks Spanish as well. One press, and every word on every screen changes.
say.es: La Plataforma entera habla inglés también. Una pulsación, y cambia cada palabra de cada pantalla.

say.en: So you can trade, and nobody learns who you are until you decide they should. That is the whole point of Jericho.
say.es: Así puede negociar, y nadie sabe quién es usted hasta que usted decida que deba saberlo. Ese es el sentido de Jericho.
